response_body.subject: RE: CardioCloud Consult CSCM Accreditation Verification — Official Response (CON-206)
response_body.body:
Dear Dr. Chen Rui,

Thank you for your inquiry regarding the CSCM accreditation status of CardioCloud Consult (submitted verification request ref. CON-206).

After reviewing our membership and accreditation registry, we can confirm the following:

CardioCloud Consult is NOT currently listed as a CSCM-accredited continuing medical education provider. Their claimed accreditation number (CSCM-2025-ECG-0047) does not correspond to any active or historical entry in our database. We have no record of a pending application from this vendor either.

We strongly advise against crediting any CME activity associated with this vendor toward CSCM-recognized Category I requirements until a formal accreditation application is submitted and approved.

If you have further questions, please contact our office directly at accreditation@cscm-china.org or call +86 10-6529-8800.

Sincerely,
Ms. Gao Yan
Membership & Accreditation Office
Chinese Society of Cardiology Medicine (CSCM)
